# Praxis Antigravity Plugin

**GENERATED PACKAGE — DO NOT EDIT. Edit the repository root and rebuild.**

Generated package for installing Praxis as a Google Antigravity (`agy`) plugin.

Install into a global `agy`:

```bash
agy plugin install ./plugins/praxis-antigravity
```

Or let a project auto-discover it via `.agents/plugins/praxis/` (`./install.sh --tool=antigravity <project>`).

Source of truth lives at the repository root. Rebuild this package with:

```bash

```
